name: PaletteProvider
description:
Hosts the command palette: a registry of commands contributed by whatever is mounted,
⌘K / Ctrl+K from anywhere to open it, and the registered commands' own shortcuts.
The palette shortcut also works while a focusable disabled button has focus, without
activating that button.
Mount once near the root; nested providers defer to the outer one.
signature: ({ children, groupOrder }: PaletteProviderProps): string | number | bigint | boolean | Iterable<ReactNode> | Promise<string | number | bigint | boolean | import("react").ReactPortal | import("react").ReactElement<unknown, string | import("react").JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | null | undefined> | import("react").JSX.Element | null | undefined

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: groupOrder
props.description: Group order; "*" marks where unlisted groups go. Defaults to `DEFAULT_PALETTE_GROUP_ORDER`.
